questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Tom is as tall (   ) his father.
questions.explanation: as + 原級 + as で「〜と同じくらい…」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: This book is (   ) than that one.
questions.explanation: than があるので比較級。長い形容詞は more を付ける。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Mt. Fuji is the (   ) mountain in Japan.
questions.explanation: the + 最上級 + in 〜 で「〜の中で最も…」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: She is the best singer (   ) the four.
questions.explanation: 最上級の範囲が「複数の人・物」のときは of、「場所・集団」のときは in。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: He runs (   ) than I do.
questions.explanation: than があるので比較級。fast の比較級は faster。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: This bag is (   ) as big as that one.
questions.explanation: 倍数 + as 〜 as で「…の〜倍」。2倍は twice。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Please speak as slowly as (   ).
questions.explanation: as 〜 as possible で「できるだけ〜」（= as 〜 as you can）。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Which do you like (   ), tea or coffee?
questions.explanation: 2つのうち「どちらがより好きか」は like 〜 better。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: This is the (   ) movie I've ever seen.
questions.explanation: 最上級 ＋ I have ever 〜「今まで〜した中で最も」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: He is not as old (   ) he looks.
questions.explanation: not as 〜 as …「…ほど〜でない」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Tokyo is larger than any other (   ) in Japan.
questions.explanation: 比較級 ＋ than any other ＋ 単数名詞 ＝ 最上級の意味。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: No other student in the class is (   ) than Ken.
questions.explanation: No other 〜 is 比較級 than …「…より〜なものはない」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: This is (   ) better than that.
questions.explanation: 比較級を強めるのは much や far。very は使えない。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: The more you read, the (   ) you learn.
questions.explanation: the 比較級 〜, the 比較級 …「〜すればするほど…」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: She is one of the (   ) players on the team.
questions.explanation: one of the 最上級 ＋ 複数名詞。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: I have three times as many books (   ) you.
questions.explanation: 〜 times as … as 〜「〜倍…」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Which is (   ), the sun or the moon?
questions.explanation: 2つを比べるときは比較級。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: He can't run as fast (   ) his brother.
questions.explanation: not as 〜 as …。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: Nothing is (   ) important than health.
questions.explanation: 「健康ほど大切なものはない」。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: This is by (   ) the best way.
questions.explanation: by far ＋ 最上級で強調。
